change.title: fix(git): replace Git sidebar status letters with icons (#215)
change.description:
## Summary

Replace truncated single-letter Git status badges (`M`, `U`, `D`) in the Git panel file list with fixed-size Lucide icons on the left of each row, and remove the duplicate legacy file-type indicators.

## Related Issue

Closes #215

## Type of Change

- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: formatting or non-functional styling changes
- [ ] refactor: internal cleanup with no behavior change
- [ ] perf: performance improvement
- [ ] test: adds or updates tests
- [ ] build: build or dependency changes
- [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes
- [ ] chore: maintenance or tooling
- [ ] revert: reverts a previous change

## What Changed

- Added `GitStatusBadge` in `GitPanel.tsx` with color-coded Lucide icons per `GitFileStatus` (Pencil, FileQuestion, Minus, Plus, RotateCcw, Check) plus `title` / `aria-label`.
- Removed `getFileIcon` and the duplicate left file-type indicators.
- Placed the status badge as the sole left column indicator; row actions remain on the right on hover.
- Constrained filename truncation to the middle column so status icons are not clipped.

## How It Was Tested

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] Not applicable

## Screenshots or Recordings

<!-- UI change — please verify in Git panel with modified / untracked / deleted files -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I updated docs when needed
- [ ] I added or updated tests when needed

commits.message:
fix(git): replace sidebar status letters with icons (#215)

Use fixed-size Lucide status badges and place them before row actions so M/U/D indicators are not clipped when hover controls appear.
refactor(git): move status icons to left, drop duplicate file icons

merge: resolve dev conflict in GitPanel row actions

Keep dev visibility for selected/active rows and PR shrink-0 on action controls.
